note: Ontonagon County's official parcel map is the Colligo GIS viewer (colligogis.com), a login-gated application, not a public ArcGIS REST service or file download. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online found no Ontonagon County parcel FeatureServer or MapServer. countygismaps.com says parcel records for Ontonagon are not yet available. The parcel datasets found (Dynamo Spatial, Regrid, Equator Studios, Acrevalue) are commercial, not county-published services. The WUPPDR partial-coverage viewer links back to the county equalization page, which points to Colligo.
